description: This file defines a readonly struct GenericGrainType that encapsulates a parametrized GrainType within the Orleans framework, providing functionality for parsing, constructing, and managing generic grain types at runtime.

classes.name: GenericGrainType
classes.description: A struct representing a generic grain type with associated arity, including methods for creation, parsing, and conversion.

methods.name: TryParse
methods.description: Attempts to parse a GrainType into a GenericGrainType, based on its generic arity.

methods.name: GetUnconstructedGrainType
methods.description: Returns a non-constructed (generic definition) version of the current GenericGrainType.

methods.name: Construct
methods.description: Constructs a specialized version of the generic grain type with the provided type arguments using a specified formatter.

methods.name: GetArguments
methods.description: Retrieves the type arguments used in this generic grain type via a specified type converter.
